server.name: community-consolelog
server.version: consolelog-mcp (npm latest at image build time)
server.note: Drawn in frame order at position 562 of Frame 3, block 5. Twenty seven tools, none annotated and none taking a path, file or directory argument. Three are exercised as representatives: a hash, a random generator and a formatter. HOME is observed here, unlike most specs, because it is the only place a tool without a path argument could leave state.
